headline: R-TYPE learns to throw: the options go hunting
lede: Press N (seat one) or H (seat two) and both golden orbs rip off the mounts and streak down the lane as one-shot drones — soft Bydo die with them, armour burns them, and a fresh O pod re-arms the rack. Firepower out, safety out: the arcade's aggressive option play is live on the shelf.

notes.text: POLISH #2925 shipped to main (PR #2926, 03dfd39): one-shot option drones with spend-on-kill, armour refusal, horizon spend, spare-O re-arm, and per-hull co-op symmetry — verified live in the deployed chunk.
The throw is a trade, not a tax: spend the pair and the next O pod arms a fresh pair (500, not a spare's 1000). Flying orbs fire nothing — the mirrored wall travels with the drones.
Harness grew honestly: 18 new rtypecheck laws (199/199) and two named mutants, launch-deaf + rearm-deaf (20 total, all red-and-named). Winnability floors untouched — the autopilot never throws.
Board stays warm: the phone-pad THROW (#2931) was filed and claimed right after the merge, and the QA lane is still deep in Double Dragon polish.
